title: An HTML comment on its own line inside a `<span>` splits the paragraph in two
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`. An HTML comment on its own line inside a `` is pulled out of the paragraph, which is split around it, leaving broken, unbalanced HTML. Input: `markdown.markdown('\n\n\n')` Expected: `

\n\n

` Actual: `

\n\n

` Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
